subject: HOF Gen6 coarse-90: opening-phase authority quarantine + field-proven false-close mechanism
body: Completed research-only coarse-90 lane against main 699ed29288ab2aa24463902fcefe752d432717d2. Field attempt=1 proves WakeHint at trusted 0.0, then 834 ms later coarse PUBLIC_STANDARD 90 is promoted, then semantic accept occurs within 1 ms, while first Samsung precise does not return for another 544 ms. Separate earlier opening proves second-order direction inversion: coarse 90 -> first precise 84 satisfies STRONG_CLOSE_SAMPLE_DEG=5 and immediately drives INNER_HANDOFF->CLOSING_INTENT->COVER_PREWARMING during opening. Root cause is unguarded coarse promotion in Fold7AngleAuthority.offerPublic/promotePublic/expirePrecise/revokePreciseSession; filtering in FoldOverlayService is too late because HingeAngleSource.lastAngle already mutates. Recommended hotfix: opening-PHASE coarse quarantine at authority boundary, keyed by attempt id for telemetry but NOT using attempt-owner lifetime as guard lifetime; keep coarse candidates shadow-only through opening until OPEN_INNER/corroborated-closed/abort terminal. Existing attempt identity persists through open until later closed terminal, so directly using gen6OpeningAttempts.current()!=null would leak guard into closing. Android-free model/fuzz PASS: 100k opening cases, zero coarse semantic escapes; 100k closing differential cases with quarantine inactive, zero policy mismatches. Research package contains full report, integration sketch, model, and results. No production Git writes.
